title: Gallformers import — shared definitions
description: Definitions shared by taxonomy batches and gall batches: the envelope, the Source block, taxon references, evidence, and controlled-value wrappers. DRAFT (format v3, 2026-10-07). See PRODUCER_GUIDE.md for the rules a schema cannot express.

envelope.description: Fields every batch carries. Each batch schema adds its own content and fixes batch_type.

format.description: Identifies the file as a Gallformers import batch.

format_version.description: Bumped only for breaking changes to the shape.

vocabulary_version.description: Date of the vocabulary files (vocab/) the producer used. Vocabularies grow without a format_version bump; this tells the validator which lists apply.

batch_type.description: Taxonomy batches are applied before gall batches from the same Source.

mode.description: replace: a whole re-run of this Source; replaces all of the Source's existing attributions of this batch_type. add: new statements that leave existing attributions alone. Gallformers batches are always add.

batch_id.description: Unique ID for this batch (a UUID is recommended). Used in the audit trail.

producer.description: Who or what produced the batch. model and instructions_version let the golden regression set trace output changes to model or prompt changes.

model.description: The model used, if any (exact model ID).

instructions_version.description: Version of the prompt/skill set used, if any.

source.description: Exactly one Source per batch: Gallformers itself (when it has the gallformers key), otherwise a document Source.

gallformers_source.description: Gallformers' own statements (author: Gallformers Contributors). No bibliographic fields; each statement carries its own date and text in its evidence. Batches with this Source must use mode add.

document_source.description: A publication, website, database, unpublished work, or research data.

gallformers_source_id.description: Optional. If given, the validator checks it matches the bibliographic fields; otherwise Gallformers matches or creates the Source.

authors.description: Names exactly as written, in order. Not parsed.

authored.description: The single date that decides recency. For websites: the date of the version read — the stated last-modified date if the site gives one, otherwise the access date.

as_written.description: The date as the Source states it, e.g. '1999 with ongoing revisions, accessed 2022'.

citation.description: The full citation as it should be displayed.

as_written.description: The license or rights statement as found, or 'not stated'.

document.description: The phase-0 structured document (a DoclingDocument, document.json) beside this batch, or null with a reason.

none.description: Why there is no document, e.g. 'scanned, unreadable'. Quotes are still required but cannot be verified.

retracts.description: If this Source is a retraction notice: the Source it retracts. Retraction cancels all of that Source's stances; the Source stays visible, marked.

taxon_ref.description: A taxon the Source names, declared once and referred to by ref. Write the name exactly as the Source does; Gallformers resolves it (current names plus synonyms). Never map names to IDs yourself.

new.description: Only when the Source itself claims novelty (sp. nov., gen. nov., comb. nov., stat. nov.). Never because a name failed to resolve.

gallformers_taxon_id.description: Optional; checked against the name. Omit unless certain.

act_id.description: Batch-unique taxonomic act ID: a1, a2, …

stance.description: deny only when the Source explicitly says so. Omission is never denial.

evidence.description: At least one per Fact or act. A quote from the document, or (Gallformers batches only) a dated statement.

quote_evidence.description: Evidence from the Source's document: a verbatim quote anchored to the item it appears in, or a whole item. Gallformers resolves and stores the exact location (item + character span) itself; producers never give offsets.

item.description: Reference of the document item the evidence comes from (a DoclingDocument self_ref, e.g. '#/texts/42'). Required whenever the batch has a document. The PDF page comes from the item's provenance.

quote.description: Verbatim text from the item, long enough to be unambiguous within it. The validator checks it appears there.

whole_item.description: The evidence is the item's entire text (e.g. a descriptive paragraph); Gallformers takes the text from the document. Only with item, never with quote, and only when the batch has a document.

page.description: Page number as PRINTED in the Source (for citations), if known — not the PDF page index, which comes from the item.

url.description: Deep link to this place in the Source (e.g. a scanned-book page or a website's species page).

statement_evidence.description: Gallformers batches only: Gallformers' own statement.

unmapped.description: Source terms that fit no vocabulary value, so no Fact was made from them. They travel with the batch for review and show where the vocabulary should grow. Never force a term into the nearest value instead.

slot.description: Which vocabulary it would have belonged to.

gall.description: The Gall it describes, if any (gall batches).

note.description: Optional: why no value fits, or a suggested new value.

observations.description: Observations the statement cites. Observations are evidence, never Sources.
